messages:
Evan M.: heads-up — enabling fp8 kernels on the L40S canary and I'm seeing a strange accuracy/quality delta vs our H100 baseline. quick notes below, opening a short triage thread.
Sarah G.: can you give the metrics (ppl/accuracy) and which model/version?
Evan M.: model: rwd-13b-v1, baseline float32 on H100 ppl=18.7. L40S fp8 default flags ppl=19.3 (+3.2% relative). H100 fp8 run was fine (18.8). So issue seems L40S-specific.
Priya R.: any diff in scale mode? per_tensor vs per_channel?
Evan M.: good call — default on L40S runtime was per_tensor. I tried per_channel and re-ran a small eval: ppl=18.9 (much closer). Quick debug print: ```layer3 chan9 mean=0.00012 std=0.0043 scale_pt=0.001 scale_pc=0.0041```
Matt W.: hmm that suggests some channels have very low dynamic range, per-tensor quantization is collapsing them. Could be non-uniform activation distribution across channels producing huge relative rounding error.
Evan M.: also saw a weird longseq tail regression: tokens after ~1024 degrade in coherence on L40S fp8 but not on H100. Might be kv-cache tiling interaction.
Priya R.: tiling differences can change accumulation ordering and rounding noise. What tiling / accumulator width does L40S kernel use?
Matt W.: L40S kernel uses 16-bit intermediate accumulators in this kernel path; H100 uses 32-bit accumulation for the same opshape. That could amplify quantization noise when scales are tiny.
Evan M.: reproducible local snippet: ```prompt: "In 2020 the main cause was" -> float: "a supply chain..."; L40S fp8 (per_tensor): "a supply chain..." but with weird filler tokens and higher perplexity. Switching to per_channel + min_scale clip fixed most examples.```
Priya R.: suggestion: 1) force per_channel scaling for canary, 2) add min_scale fallback (e.g. min_scale=1e-3) for channels below threshold, 3) add scale histogram logging per-layer to catch long tails. Bisect plan: toggle per_channel/per_tensor, toggle accumulator path (legacy vs new), toggle tiling 16/32.
quant-bot: canary job created — job q-5821 queued: compare flags [per_tensor, per_channel, per_channel+min_scale], runtime: l40s-canary-3. Link: https://ci.redwood/q-5821
Sarah G.: nice. also try running an AWQ/GPTQ preproc compare on the same checkpoints to rule out weight quantization asymmetry.
Evan M.: ran quick test: AWQ preproc + per_channel on L40S -> ppl=18.85; GPTQ preproc + per_channel -> ppl=18.9. So preproc matters a bit but main delta is scale behavior + accumulator path.
Matt W.: action items: Evan to run full 1k-sample eval with per_channel+min_scale on canary, Priya to add scale histograms and alert if >0.1% channels under min_scale, me to add a release note about L40S kernel accumulator differences and fallback.
Evan M.: sounds good. I'll post q-5821 results when finished. thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya R.: one more note — if we add min_scale we should also test semantic regressions (LLM evals, safety prompts). small clipping can sometimes bias logits.
Evan M.: agreed. will run both numeric (ppl) and semantic evals. will flag regressions in the job summary.
Matt W.: FYI add to rollout checklist: "verify per_channel scaling on L40S or enable min_scale fallback" so we don't flip kernel on by accident.
Evan M.: will do. closing thread for now, will update with job link + artifacts. :shipit:
